truth_law: Research and regulatory evidence are market signals, not relationship, consent, certification, pipeline, revenue, or customer proof.

wedges.proof_boundary: Dealix assesses workflow, evidence, integration gaps and execution readiness; it does not issue tax rulings or certify ZATCA compliance.

wedges.proof_boundary: Dealix prepares evidence, governance workflows and readiness packs; only the competent authority can issue the accreditation or badge.
